# WA Lookup WhatsApp Bulk Business Check
> Official examples for the WA Lookup bulk product `ws_business_batch`.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://walookup.com/products/ws_business_batch): Check a whole list for WhatsApp Business accounts — separate from the activity check, this one answers only whether each number runs a Business account.
- [API documentation](https://walookup.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/walookup/whatsapp-bulk-business-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://walookup.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://walookup.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: WA Lookup.
- Product code: ws_business_batch.
- Mode: asynchronous bulk task.
- API base URL: https://walookup.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Submit: POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with product=ws_business_batch, country and a file field.
- Poll: GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id}; status is processing, success or failed.
- Poll interval: no more than once every 30 seconds.
- Task size: 1000 to 100000 entries, .txt or .csv, one phone number per line.
- Input kind: phone.
- Country: required, one country per task.
- Result columns: number, whatsapp, business.
- Billing: the file is reserved on submit; only checked entries are charged and the rest is returned. Failed tasks are refunded.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
